subject.title: fix(chat): keep proof decision out of actor closure

question: Should `lockProofDecision` and `unlockProofDecision` be accepted as the permanent synchronization boundary for queued chat cancellation versus canonical proof in `OpenClawChatSQLiteTranscriptCache.cancelCommand`?
rationale: The patch appears behavior-preserving, but the private lock boundary controls message-delivery outcomes that CI cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
options.body: Merge after the owner agrees the manual lock/defer pattern preserves the previous proof decision, SQLite commit, and cache cleanup serialization.

options.title: Request Safer Helper Shape
options.body: Ask for a narrow helper or scoped shape that avoids the actor-isolated closure capture while making the lock lifetime harder to widen by accident.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after the owner agrees the manual lock/defer pattern preserves the previous proof decision, SQLite commit, and cache cleanup serialization.
